name: "Concise Writing"
description: "Use when writing product artifacts, plans, specifications, decisions, reviews, findings, summaries, or agent reports. Requires crisp language containing only decision-useful information."
applyTo: "**/idea-brief.md, **/research-report.md, **/synthesis.md, **/product-spec-*.md, **/red-team-report.md, **/architecture/*.md, **/design/*.md, **/implementation/*.md"

# Concise Writing

- Include only text needed to convey the decision, evidence, requirement, risk, rationale, or next action.
- State the point first. Use short, direct sentences and precise terms.
- Remove repetition, throat-clearing, generic commentary, decorative prose, and template filler.
- Do not restate source material when a link and a concise implication are sufficient.
- Preserve necessary context, uncertainty, evidence limits, acceptance criteria, and trade-offs; concision must not hide material information.
- Prefer a compact paragraph or list over extra headings and nested structure.
